name: pocketstation
description: Native desktop audio Sessions for Node and Relay receiving for browsers

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:typescript
scripts.build:native: node tools/clean-native-output.mjs && napi build --platform --release --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --output-dir native-dist
scripts.api:check: npm run build:typescript && api-extractor run && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.browser.json && api-extractor run --config api-extractor.root.json
scripts.api:update: npm run build:typescript && api-extractor run --local && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.browser.json && api-extractor run --local --config api-extractor.root.json
scripts.native:check: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml
